summary: Disturbance between roommates in the 500 block of Delfino Lane.
A landlord was reported trying to remove a tenant without an eviction notice in the 1300 block of Shasta Drive.
Roughly 50 vehicles were reported moving eastbound on Westside Parkway approaching Calloway Drive; units tried to identify them as the group split toward the Truxtun Avenue off-ramp and Highway 99.
A vehicle left the road, went down a ravine and came to rest near downed power lines; the occupants got out and were reported possibly trying to reach the water.
Deputies checked on four juveniles ages 2 to 7 reported running in and out of the roadway unsupervised in Lake of the Woods, with adults yelling at the children.

disposition: suspect held at gunpoint, second suspect at large
summary: A Breckenridge Road resident reported holding a burglary suspect at gunpoint after an earlier break-in at the home. A second suspect fled in a black GMC, and a neighbor reported the vehicle heading south on Comanche Drive as units searched the area.
Family disturbance in the 1400 block of West Point Drive in which a man was reported scaring his mother.
Family disturbance reported in the 1200 block of University Avenue.
A landlord-tenant dispute on Chester Place in which a man was reported with a foot-long knife about two hours earlier.
Fight reported in the area of Niles Street and Sterling Road.
Welfare check on a woman who reported being kicked out and was waiting at a transit stop in the 100 block of South King Street.
Hit-and-run reported in the 4000 block of Wible Road involving a white sedan.
Suspicious person reported at a car wash at Lincoln Street and Airport Drive.
Audible burglary alarm at a business in the 5300 block of District Boulevard.
Hit-and-run crash in which the driver fled on foot after a vehicle rolled over.
Three-vehicle collision in the 1800 block of University Avenue; crews found one vehicle against a parked car and one rolled over, with no patients on scene.
Battery reported in the 200 block of Newquist Drive.
Welfare check in the 4800 block of Kinshaw Court for a person known to have firearms; none were seen.
Roommate disturbance in the 200 block of Newquist Drive; one person was refusing to let the other inside.
Group of four or five men reported loitering and harassing customers at a store in the 1900 block of Union Avenue.
Assault with a deadly weapon with no injuries; a man reportedly showed a black pistol before fleeing in an early-2000s SUV.
An at-risk missing person alert went out after the subject's debit card was used at a Chevron station; the person was believed to be in a Honda CR-V.
Neighbor dispute over loud stomping and talking reported at a Terra Vista apartment complex.
Audible alarm at a building in the 400 block of Truxtun Avenue, with activation at the east door.
Disturbance in the 1800 block of Endes Street involving a man on parole.
A woman whispering on the phone told dispatchers she was locked inside a car parked in front of a home in the 2500 block of Ledgewiew Lane.

disposition: driver out, minor to moderate injuries
summary: Three-vehicle crash in front of a business in the 1100 block of East Truxtun Avenue with a possible pin-in and a dark-colored SUV; the driver was out of the vehicle with minor to moderate injuries.
Two shots reported heard at a mobile home park on Coconut Way just north of West Columbus Street; nothing else was seen or heard.
